training.initialization: independent normal weights with std sqrt(2/fan_in), zero biases
training.loss: mean softmax cross entropy + 0.0001/2 * sum(weight^2), biases unregularized

quantization: floor(parameter * 1024 + 0.5); after each dot floor((integer_dot + 512)/1024), then integer bias; ties toward positive infinity
selection_policy: one fixed training run; no test evaluation before frozen model and bound admission; no test tuning, retraining, clipping, or replacing examples; preserve diagnostics including nonconvergence
